desktop-credential-status.title: Local execution authorization record
desktop-credential-status.renewing: Submitting authorization renewal for the original node…
desktop-credential-status.unknown: The original renewal result is unconfirmed. Check that operation before continuing.
desktop-credential-status.connect_after: Explicitly connect after renewal. Tasks will not be dispatched automatically.
desktop-credential-status.reason.executi: An original execution or external operation remains unverified. Confirm its outcome before checking the original renewal.
desktop-credential-status.reason.local_s: Local records are not ready. Check whether the original process has stopped and preserve the existing records.
desktop-credential-status.reason.credent: The original execution identity's credential state has changed. Check that identity and its current permissions before continuing.
desktop-credential-status.reason.access_: Current access permissions have changed. Restore access, then check the original renewal.
desktop-credential-status.reason.context: The original project directory or code baseline has changed. Check the original directory and baseline before continuing.
desktop-credential-status.reason.result_: The renewal result is unconfirmed. Continue checking the same original request.
